confirmedCodeFindings.finding: Progress 1 is emitted after native frame0 stability proof, frame0 draw/readback/hash/PNG, checkpoint file write, and encoder stdin write plus required drain. It does not prove one encoded video frame.
confirmedCodeFindings.incidentApplication: Conditional on reported state reflecting this unchanged deployed progress contract; raw progress not retrieved.

confirmedCodeFindings.finding: elapsedSeconds is saved on state writes. During CAPTURE a progress change triggers the write; status returns the stored value. Frozen 12.43 seconds is last saved elapsed time, not proof of process age or death.

Supervisor enforces the approved total capture deadline, parent liveness and owned descendant cleanup. seconds is capped at 600. Individual page.evaluate and encoder drain do not have separate deadlines.

CAPTURE_RECEIPT and FRAME_EVIDENCE are written in finally after browser cleanup. Browser diagnostic snapshots are written on exit/failure. Forced container stop can preclude completed evidence/export; this is a mechanism, not confirmed incident causation.

Quality change to generated capture is one director_events HTTP alias. Capture loop, encoder handoff, progress and total deadline logic were not changed. New label/map loops are finite and synchronous; no direct stall defect established.

Prior A6 quality PASS covers 300 layout frames and 22 sparse software-drawn PNGs, not continuous NVIDIA capture-to-FFmpeg encoding. Frame0 PNG is 2770634 bytes. No previous PASS is invalidated by a failure outside that scope.

Existing capture_operation_diagnostics.mjs provides a bounded-schema recorder and atomic operation checkpoints, but generated capture does not call it. It is a reuse option for a later evidence-preservation change, not a proven stall fix or new quality regression.
